conclusions.co_ke_http: 503 was the network proxy upstream-connection failure, not a proven origin-application HTTP response.
conclusions.co_ke_public_dns: Both resolvers return NXDOMAIN for apex NS/DS and www A. The negative authority is ke. This observes public DNS absence, not registration or ownership status.
conclusions.com_dnssec: Both resolvers returned NOERROR with no DS answer and parent com SOA/NSEC3 evidence; no published DS observed. DNSKEY query also returned no answer. No independent cryptographic validation performed.
conclusions.registered_glue: Not established. Direct parent queries on UDP/TCP53 failed from this environment and registry RDAP returned503. Recursive NXDOMAIN does not prove absence of registrar host objects.
conclusions.tag: G-WCKVHN823V appears in both the public loader URL and gtag config of the successful .com homepage. No GTM-/UA-/AW- IDs were found in that fetched HTML. JavaScript was not executed and tag collection/account access was not verified.
conclusions.vanity_ns_public_dns: ns1, ns2, ns3, ns4.waithakandegwa.com all NXDOMAIN; not the returned authoritative NS names.
